sessionStart.bash: mkdir -p logs && now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) && ms=$(date +%s%3N) && echo "$ms" > logs/.strategist-session-start && printf '{"event":"sessionStart","at":"%s","epoch_ms":%s}\n' "$now" "$ms" >> logs/strategist-sessions.jsonl
sessionStart.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; $now=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); $ms=[int64]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()); Set-Content -Path logs/.strategist-session-start -Value $ms; Add-Content -Path logs/strategist-sessions.jsonl -Value ('{"event":"sessionStart","at":"'+$now+'","epoch_ms":'+$ms+'}')

sessionEnd.bash: now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) && end=$(date +%s%3N) && start=$(cat logs/.strategist-session-start 2>/dev/null || echo "") && dur=null && if [ -n "$start" ]; then dur=$((end-start)); fi && printf '{"event":"sessionEnd","at":"%s","epoch_ms":%s,"duration_ms":%s}\n' "$now" "$end" "$dur" >> logs/strategist-sessions.jsonl
sessionEnd.powershell: $now=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); $end=[int64]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()); $start=(Get-Content -Path logs/.strategist-session-start -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($start) { $dur=$end-[int64]$start } else { $dur='null' }; Add-Content -Path logs/strategist-sessions.jsonl -Value ('{"event":"sessionEnd","at":"'+$now+'","epoch_ms":'+$end+',"duration_ms":'+$dur+'}')
